title: CLOVER Walkamin 2008–09 forecast rule comparison
generated_from: Completed APSIM baseline plus 20 GEFS 3-day rainfall-rule scenarios for Walkamin 2008–09
forecast_rule: Hold irrigation when P(next 3-day rainfall ≥ selected rainfall threshold) ≥ selected probability threshold; maximum 2 consecutive hold days.
notes: All 20 combinations of four rainfall thresholds and five probability thresholds were completed successfully.
All scenarios used 400 mm across 8 irrigation events in this season; forecast information changed irrigation timing rather than seasonal irrigation total.
Forecast values are retrieved on irrigation decision dates reached by each strategy, not as a complete daily GEFS archive.
Proof-of-concept thresholds are not final agronomic recommendations.
